study.question: Observed trajectory: static/pooled/DIN validation AUC=0.6050036145/0.6102261137/0.6133619861. Behavior-only splitting g1-r0000-behavior_within=0.6119128872 did not improve DIN. Target-aware count information g1-r0002-joint_count=0.6171272214 was useful, but count_summary alone=0.6130945529 lost performance; semantic means plus counts g1-r0005-match_groups=0.6187998914 retained useful information. Pairing is not uniformly useful: action-age joint versus empirical-product tables scored 0.6191087654 versus 0.6186617299 in r0006, while learned content-context paired versus independent moments scored 0.6190555924 versus 0.6192439193 in r0007. The current incumbent g1-r0009-global_norm=0.6200937865 has been reproduced at the same seed by r0010-energy_mean and r0011-pooled_parent, which is deterministic reproduction, not independent support. Replacing pooled field radius by event, bundle-product and field-product energy scored 0.6197049287/0.6196579598/0.6195243395, all below the parent; bundle-product Logloss=0.1956813693 was better than parent=0.1957159095, so ranking and calibration disagree. Code inspection reveals an exact blind spot in the incumbent: within a true-match group it preserves categorical marginals but cannot distinguish their different category-brand couplings when context is fixed. At target category=brand=3, histories [(1,1),(1,1),(2,2),(2,2)] and [(1,1),(1,2),(2,1),(2,2)] with equal actions/ages have identical complete incumbent features for all parameter values (up to floating-point summation), but pair entropy log(2) versus log(4) and collision mass 1/2 versus 1/4. Does making this identity-concentration information explicit improve prediction beyond matched category/brand marginal summaries at measured cost? This is a constructed information-retention limitation, not a claim that these exact histories occur or that it is predictively consequential.
study.hypothesis: Within the same visible history and target-match partition, repeated category-brand tuples versus a wider tuple repertoire can carry click-relevant concentration information erased by pooled field marginals. Fixed empirical Shannon entropy and with-replacement collision probability can expose this information independently of learned embedding geometry. They may complement the incumbent more robustly than replacing its radius by learned event energy. This is a provisional hypothesis, not established by the failed energy implementations. Category-brand tuples are supplied bucket identities, not item IDs, distinct purchases or deduplicated physical events. Neither dataset access nor item history is invented.

inherited_components: All incumbent embeddings, dormant attention allocation, dense classifier, pooling/count/histogram/moment/field-norm features and numeric operation order
One history embedding lookup per field in forward; no learned event scorer
Paired conditional empirical-product replacement idea from r0006/r0007/r0011, but applied to categorical identity distributions instead of action-age tables or learned moments

study.proposed_difference: For each of the four existing true-match groups, restrict all new distributions to the exact same complete category-brand events (mask true, category>0, brand>0). Keep the incumbent untouched, including its use of incomplete fields. Sort packed int64 category/group, brand/group and pair/group keys in BxL memory and aggregate run counts. For run sizes k and group total n, H=log(n)-sum(k log k)/n, C=sum(k^2)/n^2, with H=C=0 when n=0. These are descriptive empirical with-replacement statistics, not unbiased population estimators. Common per-group coordinates are log1p(n)/log129, Hc/log129, Hb/log129, Cc, Cb. Joint mode adds Hcb/log129,Ccb; independent mode adds (Hc+Hb)/log129,Cc*Cb, the exact product of the same empirical marginals including self combinations; marginal mode adds two zeros; zero mode zeros all coordinates. Concatenation yields 4x7=28 inputs to the same 28->16->1 bias-free ReLU residual head in each cell, totaling 464 extra parameters (17,159,923 expected total versus parent 17,159,459). A zero final weight gives the exact incumbent initial function and an identically zero zero-input branch. The genuine pairing contrast is concentrated in the neither-match group: if category or brand is fixed by a match, joint summaries reduce to the corresponding marginal; both-match group provides no joint diversity. All variants execute all three sorts and both pair-summary alternatives. No extra histories, row/user identifiers, label statistics, learned vocabulary tables, optimizer or loss changes. Model-internal sorting does not modify host features or the protocol.
predictions: Implementation: sorted H,C should agree with an independent dense equality-count diagnostic to <=1e-5; empty and zero-length histories give zero new features and residual; masked padding, sequence reversal and joint bijective renaming of valid category/brand IDs leave new summaries unchanged to <=1e-5.

Implementation: reversing eligible brand values within each existing semantic group preserves complete-pair support, category/brand marginal features, independent summaries, membership and incumbent features to floating-point tolerance, but can change joint summaries. The fixed two-history witness must have identical incumbent/common/independent features and joint entropy gap log2 and collision gap 0.25. These are algebra checks, not predictive ablations or interventions on labels.

Predictive screen at the frozen full protocol: joint_identity should improve full-population validation AUC over both independent_identity and zero_identity, with a predeclared consequential screen difference >=0.0002 against each, and exceed marginal_identity; report Logloss and all host slice counts/metrics without treating them as independent samples. Any first-seed improvement remains preliminary. Marginal-only versus zero tests explicit marginal concentration; independent versus marginal tests the additional nonlinear marginal readout basis rather than new information.

Mechanism support requires the matched joint-versus-independent result and invariance checks, then three paired seeds for a retained joint candidate and closest controls when host phase/budget allows. Report paired seed variation and host-provided user-cluster uncertainty if available; do not invent intervals without permitted per-user outputs.

Cost: three BxL sorts add O(B L log L) operations and O(B L) statistic storage, plus 464 parameters. No BxLxL tensor appears in forward. Measure host full wall/allocated GPU seconds, parameters, examples, peak memory, throughput and batch p50/p95 including feature gathering. Equal training passes are mechanism isolation, not an equal-compute claim. Sorting overhead may make this a useful information diagnostic but a worse quality-cost tradeoff.
falsifiers: Sorted/dense disagreement >1e-5, complete-support mismatch, nonfinite outputs, nonzero empty residual, witness failure or marginal-change leakage invalidates this implementation and its attribution. Correct within the same charged budget before interpreting predictive scores. A tiny floating-point negative mutual information may be numerical; a value <-1e-5 needs investigation.

If joint_identity does not improve versus independent_identity at matched recipe/capacity, the current experiment does not support incremental predictive value of these pair-concentration statistics. If marginal or independent controls explain any gain, do not credit identity pairing.

If all new summaries are no better than zero_identity, the exact information collision is not shown to be consequential for this implementation. This does not refute all tuple-repetition mechanisms, histories beyond 128, behavior-conditioned repetition or alternative estimators.

If the zero-input model does not reproduce incumbent training at the same seed, inspect the authorized receipt before attributing changes; extra allocation can affect host RNG continuation/sample-order behavior or numeric execution despite identical initial parent parameters. All four current cells share allocation/RNG consumption. Same-checkpoint zero-branch identity must still hold.

A positive single-seed AUC result with unstable paired repetitions, worse measured quality-cost, or material Logloss regression limits the conclusion and cannot establish a general mechanism or an industry transfer claim.
alternative_explanations: Empirical entropy and collision estimates depend on visible count and the truncated history window. Common explicit n/Hc/Hb/Cc/Cb controls reduce but do not eliminate finite-sample, missingness, vocabulary-hashing and support confounds.

Differences can reflect the added residual parameterization, native feature scales (independent entropy may reach twice a marginal entropy), or an easier nonlinear marginal basis. Independent and marginal replacements have identical allocated capacity but different active feature information; zero is a function anchor, not an equal-active-capacity information control.

Shared categorical pairs are coarse identities, not items. Repetition could reflect category/brand coding or exposure frequency rather than interest persistence, causal influence or repeated products. No claim transfers to item-aware systems.

Prior source and this shallow model use different labels, fields and data splits. Industry ranking/results do not transfer. No auxiliary conversion delay, additional domains, longer history or source training recipe is available or adopted.

All prior comparisons and current first-round suite use selected validation seed 42; extensive adaptive selection and seed noise can explain small differences. Deterministic same-seed repetitions are reproducibility checks, not independent mechanism tests. No test information is accessible.
The host static snapshot as-of dates remain undocumented. This benchmark assumes static attributes and cannot establish production point-in-time validity.
